inspected_flow: One sequential raw observation; freeze social suffix before LTM update; auditory update, original X, physical suffix; read bootstrap before previous-row recreation/update; current LRU allocation and epsilon choice; Vocal Q uses original X; action/reproduction/emission/physiology/reward; terminal update immediately else pending until next real observation; newborns next tick. Physical/vocal capacity256, zero priors, all algorithms unchanged.
archive_reuse: v073 ordered outcomes, original-key catalogs, actual retained histograms and physical-Q/pending digests; v072 ecological and exposure/movement strata. No new B/C500 recordings required. Age=own opportunity index exactly under complete-from-birth records; visibility/here recoverable from original X, quantities/acquisition unavailable.
family: Single frozen piecewise time-inhomogeneous hold/resample Markov process. Calendar tick only selects epoch. Stationary private uniform at construction mapped through current epoch CDF on first actual turn; subsequent turns hold with alpha(t), else resample pi(t). No X/social/ID/resources/reward/outcome feedback. Epoch starts0,100,200,300,400; last continues. No reset on epoch boundary.
fit: Per epoch, equal-seed token frequencies pi and empirical same-token rates from calibration3/4. alpha=(same-sum(pi^2))/(1-sum(pi^2)), saturated at[0,1] only if necessary and explicitly flagged. No search/reward/performance tuning. Analytical moments approximate transient nonstationary mixture; measured full fixed-X calibration null audits limitations.
windows: [0,100),[100,200),[200,300),[300,400),[400,500); no tick0 decisions, tick500 only in full diagnostics. Pilot gate uses complete [0,100) plus full100, reports tick100 partial separately but does not gate on incomplete window.
matching_support: Conditional-TV original-X common cells>=20 decisions in EACH run; coverage>=10% of decisions in EACH. Unsupported essential checks are NA and block primary. Plug-in distribution/entropy diagnostics, not significance tests. Per-seed/per-realization/per-complete-window AND full-run targets must ALL pass; no moderate-failure override.
matching_rationale: Preserve v073 H=.25/F=.02/visits10%/same=.05. Add explicit conditional gross=.50 (2x target), marginal TV .10, conditional TV .25, empirical window-clipped run-CDF KS .15, states-once .05 and effective count20%. Conservative finite-sample diagnostics, every denominator retained; failure is valid.
censoring: Own-opportunity segments, left-boundary and death/end right censoring explicit. CDF of clipped segments is descriptive, not an uncensored lifespan estimate.
online_nuisance_seed: 20000+100*eco_seed+realization, realization0/1; model K isolates D/E streams
replay: High priority, independent of online gate. Validate A/B/C0/1/2 full500 source digests before alternatives. Fixed B/C experience A,B,C,D,E and B+independent remembered-direction projection of E; projection is diagnostic-only66 possible slots, holds actual B fixed. Two nuisance realizations; seed50000+100*eco+r. Retain actual actions, reward, terminal, read-before-update,LRU256, pending cutoff; no ecological evaluation.

prediction.method: Prespecified hierarchical categorical frequency predictor; min20 per cell, Dirichlet strength5. X,A backs off to action prior. Extended token backs off/smooths to X,A. C remembered feature backs off to X,B,A. Same test decisions for all models; all + common supported subset. No model sweep.
prediction.future_cumulative_reward: Sum of next5 ACTUAL own-decision rewards (exclude current); same fixed bins. If fewer5 available, censored by observed death vs run end. No invented absorbing rewards.
prediction.survival: Alive after tick t+5; known observed death before/at horizon gives0; actual t+5 row alive gives1; alive but insufficient future observation is end-censored. No resource-acquisition target: field unavailable.
prediction.memory_specific: On C experience compare X,B,A vs X,B,RD,A, and X,B,U_RD,A; hold actual B fixed. U_RD is canonical remembered-direction projection of independent37-category process. No individual IDs.
prediction.limits: Observational, action-conditioned, independent eco n3; no policy/survival benefit claim from prediction or replay.

gate: Primary500 only if every frozen pilot check passes, none unsupported. Any gross mismatch blocks. Preserve failed pilot; no redesign after evaluation. Stop methodological phase after report; v0.8 ecology design is documentation only.
